identity_resolution.conclusion: SBIC East, SBIC Central and SBIC West are the regional English identifiers of three separate Japanese Small and Medium Business Investment & Consultation companies created under the Small and Medium Business Investment & Consultation Companies Act (Act No. 101 of 1963). They are not SBI Holdings, Inc. The acronym overlap is not evidence of common ownership or an XRP relationship.

statutory_basis.law_name_ja: 中小企業投資育成株式会社法
statutory_basis.law_name_en: Small and Medium Business Investment & Consultation Companies Act
statutory_basis.article_2: Names exactly three companies: Tokyo Small and Medium Business Investment & Consultation Co., Ltd.; Nagoya Small and Medium Business Investment & Consultation Co., Ltd.; and Osaka Small and Medium Business Investment & Consultation Co., Ltd., with principal offices in Tokyo, Nagoya and Osaka respectively.
statutory_basis.article_3: Restricts use of the statutory company name to companies covered by the Act.
statutory_basis.source_note: The House of Representatives page reproduces the enacted 1963 statute. The e-Gov law page confirms the law identifier/current-law record; its browser rendering did not expose readable article text in this capture.

separate_sbi_holdings_entity.legal_name_ja: SBIホールディングス株式会社
separate_sbi_holdings_entity.principal_business: Control and management of the SBI Group through share ownership.
separate_sbi_holdings_entity.distinction: SBI Holdings is a separate financial-services holding company established in 1999. The three SBIC regional companies are named separately in Act No. 101 of 1963 and identify one another as sister companies. No SBI Holdings parent/subsidiary relationship is established by the official profiles reviewed.

relationship_to_sbi_holdings.interpretation: Do not treat SBIC East/Central/West as SBI Holdings, SBI VC Trade, SBI Shinsei Bank or SBI Crypto. Do not infer common control from the letters SBIC/SBI.
relationship_to_sbi_holdings.caveat: This is a scoped source conclusion, not a claim that every possible historical transaction or minority shareholding has been exhaustively ruled out.

chatgpt_phrase_reconciliation.hypothesis: The phrase may refer to Japanese SBIC regional companies using ChatGPT in investee-company or professional training. The original utterance/source context is unavailable, so the intended referent remains unconfirmed.

sbi_holdings_chatgpt_distinction.separate_relationship: SoftBank Group Corp. and OpenAI announced an enterprise AI partnership and later formed SB OAI Japan GK.
sbi_holdings_chatgpt_distinction.interpretation: SoftBank Group/SB OAI Japan is a distinct corporate relationship. It must not be conflated with the statutory SBIC East/Central/West companies or with SBI Holdings, Inc.

xrp_relationship_assessment.scope: Official company profiles, statutory identity and the scoped public phrase search.
xrp_relationship_assessment.caveat: Absence in this scoped review is not proof that no regional company has ever held an indirect investment in a company with digital-asset exposure. No direct SBIC-to-XRP, Ripple, custody, trading, payment or partnership edge is admitted.
